name: example-motion-opus-design-lab
title: Opus Motion Design Lab
description: A 15-second interactive motion-design lab for OPUS 5.5, demonstrating spacing, typography, motion blur, easing, follow-through and anticipation before revealing motion designer CLAUDE.

description_i18n.en: A 15-second interactive motion-design lab for OPUS 5.5, demonstrating spacing, typography, motion blur, easing, follow-through and anticipation before revealing motion designer CLAUDE.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 一段 15 秒的 OPUS 5.5 互动动效设计实验室演示，依次展示间距、排版、运动模糊、缓动、跟随与预备动作，最后揭晓动效设计师 CLAUDE。

inputs.name: labTitle
inputs.label: Lab title
inputs.default: OPUS 5.5 / YOUR F*CKING MOTION DESIGN LAB

query.en: Create a 15-second creative-coding showcase titled {{labTitle}} inside a warm off-white browser workbench, placing {{anthropicLogo}} at top left and {{claudeCodeLogo}} at top right, using electric blue {{accent}}, signal red {{warning}} and an orange {{mascotColor}} pixel guide. Open with a blue ball demonstrating spacing through a traced bounce, then assemble the oversized statement {{heroCopy}} with staggered letters and an underline. Cut to a dark stage where STRETCH, SPIN and SNAP demonstrate motion blur, then return to a light graph where a linear path becomes an ease-in-out curve. Move into a dark dotted field where a blue particle body drags a red-and-blue follow-through trail, then morph it into a circular anticipation gauge that charges from 0% to 100%. Finish on a light stage where {{designerRole}} and the large name {{designerName}} lock into place with a blue period. Keep the six-control code panel and its {{previewStrip}} visible below the stage, and let the pixel guide hop to the active control throughout.
query.zh-CN: 制作一段 15 秒的创意编程作品展示，标题为 {{labTitle}}，置于暖白色浏览器工作台中，左上放置 {{anthropicLogo}}、右上放置 {{claudeCodeLogo}}，使用电蓝色 {{accent}}、信号红 {{warning}} 和橙色 {{mascotColor}} 像素向导。开场让蓝色小球沿带残影的弹跳轨迹演示间距，随后用错落字母和下划线组装巨型宣言 {{heroCopy}}。切到深色舞台，用 STRETCH、SPIN、SNAP 展示运动模糊；再回到浅色曲线图，让线性运动变为 ease-in-out 缓动。进入深色点阵场，让蓝色主体拖出红蓝跟随尾迹，再将其变形成从 0% 充到 100% 的圆形预备动作仪表。结尾回到浅色舞台，让 {{designerRole}} 与巨型姓名 {{designerName}} 锁定成版，并以蓝色句点收束。全过程保留下方六项控制代码面板及 {{previewStrip}}，并让像素向导持续跳到当前控制项。
